# laravel_cloud_instance_sizes (Data Source)

Lists available instance sizes: the service sizes for shared compute and every managed queue size. It does not list the dedicated service sizes (dedicated.*), which an environment on a dedicated cluster needs; the Laravel Cloud dashboard shows those. Such an environment takes only the managed queue sizes whose cpu_type is dedicated (mq.dedicated.*).

~> **Beta:** This provider is in beta and may change between releases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laravel_cloud_instance_sizes" "available" {}

# Sizes for app and service instances, and the current-generation (mq.*)
# sizes for managed queues.
locals {
  instance_sizes      = [for s in data.laravel_cloud_instance_sizes.available.sizes : s.name if s.instance_class == "general"]
  managed_queue_sizes = [for s in data.laravel_cloud_instance_sizes.available.sizes : s.name if s.instance_class == "managed_queue" && startswith(s.name, "mq.")]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `sizes` (Attributes List) Available instance sizes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sizes))

<a id="nestedatt--sizes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sizes`

Read-Only:

- `compute_class` (String) Compute class (general, compute, memory).
- `cpu_count` (Number) Number of CPU cores. Managed-queue sizes may express a fractional vCPU (such as 0.5).
- `cpu_type` (String) CPU type.
- `description` (String) Size description.
- `instance_class` (String) Which instance class this size belongs to: "general" for service instances, "managed_queue" for managed queues.
- `label` (String) Human-friendly label.
- `memory_mib` (Number) Memory in MiB.
- `name` (String) Size identifier (such as flex-512mb or mq.flex.256mb).
